whether fair use applies.
So the first one is the purpose or character of the use.
What are you trying to do with it?
And none of these are hard rules.
They're just tendencies which have

So, for example, if you're trying to do something

fair use than if you're trying to sell and make

If you're trying to-- if you transform something,

The nature of the actual copyrighted work is also important.
So things that are more factual are
more likely to be fair use than fictional works.
Because if you write a summary of World War--
a page about facts about World War II,
there's less protection over my really creative poem.
And then the amount or portion of the original work.
So using a snippet is favored over the whole work.
So if you just take a little bit,

It was like, why are you--
why copyright at all is to protect and align
